item.title: Dracut/Tyngsboro erupts to roll past Nashoba Regional
item.description: LOWELL — The Middies made their own luck Monday evening. The sixth-seeded Dracut/Tyngsboro hockey team threw pucks at the net every chance it had during its Div. 3 round of 16 contest against No. 11 Nashoba Regional at the Tsongas Center and the strategy of tossing rubber en masse toward the goal paid off. item.title: Ask the Psychic: What can I do to strengthen my hunches?
item.description: In spirituality, a hunch refers to an intuitive feeling or inner sense that guides a person without the use of conscious reasoning. Many people believe that such hunches are messages from a deeper spiritual source, such as the soul, higher self, or even the Universe, nudging them toward a certain action or understanding. These experiences are often described as subtle insights or gut feelings that encourage individuals to trust their inner guidance on their spiritual journey. DEAR BONNIE: Recent
